title: Binaural Aura: Come to Bed With Me? 8 Hours Theta Binaural Beats (6 Hz) + Pacific Waves
description:
Come to bed with me? Put your headphones on. The Pacific sun sets over Sunset Cliffs, the picture softens, and a slow spiral galaxy blooms out of the sun and carries you down into the dark. By twenty minutes the screen is pure black, so nothing lights up your room. Then it's eight hours of deep Pacific swell with a soft binaural theta tone underneath.

The tone: 75 Hz in your left ear and 81 Hz in your right, so your brain hears a gentle 6 Hz beat in the theta range, the band of drowsiness and light sleep. Headphones are needed for the beat; on a speaker it's just a warm low hum. Everything you hear is generated fresh by Sandoval Studios, with no samples and no loops. This is for relaxation, not medical treatment.

REST. DIGEST. Goodnight.

#binauralbeats #thetawaves #sleepmusic #oceanwaves #blackscreen
